platform: linux (Apple Vision pose extraction and pnpm lab:regen unavailable; canonical datasets/paddle-bench/runs/ absent/gitignored)
built: packages/swing-lab/src/ballOcclusionBench.ts — state-aware ball evaluation harness: buckets every committed ball gold label (OBSERVED, ENTERING_OCCLUSION, OCCLUDED, REACQUIRED, plus NOT_VISIBLE and UNCERTAIN_EXCLUDED accounting buckets), scores tracker outputs only where committed run artifacts exist, flags any emitted point at OCCLUDED gold as a violation, and verifies bridge-point provenance (predicted:true, never colliding with canonical observation timestamps). CLI: pnpm --filter @pickle/swing-lab ball:occlusion

packages/swing-lab/test/ballOcclusionBench.test.ts — 9 replay/unit tests: bucketing (explicit occlusionState + legacy visibility), visible-point hit/miss scoring, OCCLUDED/NOT_VISIBLE abstention vs violation, unflagged-bridge detection, aggregation denominators, and full state-machine replays (successful body-emergence reacquisition, honest LOST, bridge separation) through buildBallTracks/selectPrimaryBallTrack/buildBallTimeline

packages/swing-lab/test/ballIdentityProperty.test.ts — 2 property tests: (a) 96-scenario deterministic sweep (4 decoy y-origins x 4 decoy slopes x 3 start offsets x 2 jitter levels, seeded LCG) asserting the selected primary track is composed of observations from exactly one generated ball identity; (b) 5-seed mid-flight-vanish sweep asserting reacquisition never links the adjacent-court decoy into the target rally
